name: Steam Squasher
notes: Steam multiblock: runs on steam from steam input hatches, no energy or maintenance hatch. Every tiered part (machine casing, gear box, pipe casing, firebox, frame) must be the same tier: bronze (shown) or steel (Solid Steel Machine Casing and steel parts; high-pressure steam, faster). Buses are steam input/output buses. Steam compressor (Steam Squasher), 3x3x7, at least 14 machine casings; the press blocks are Blocks of Iron (bronze tier) or Blocks of Steel (steel tier). GT still accepts the old 3x3x4 hollow form; this is the current shape. Sharing: every hatch found during the structure check is added to each controller whose structure contains it, so steam hatches and buses in a shared wall serve both machines.
